name: Fullhome Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1990 and based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, Team Young Technology Co.,Ltd. delivers intelligent power management and automation solutions throughout the country. The company's extensive product range includes smart outlet sockets, adapter plugs, power strips, and remote control devices. Additionally, they provide specialized controllers for applications such as electric roll-up doors, electronic door locks (including versions for hotels), power switches, and electric curtains.
